nodes.label: D8 event-driven only
nodes.rationale: D8 forbids blocking whole-result APIs; spawn's handle.done is an ergonomics promise derived from the 'complete' event - the event is the contract.

nodes.label: bundle-root bare specifier identity rule
nodes.rationale: Plugin-relative ../ imports break once staged through the system-plugins symlink; bare bundle-root specifiers are layout-independent, but the loader must enforce one canonical specifier per stateful module or event delivery silently splits into two instances.

nodes.label: D3 UI as pluggable Web Client
nodes.rationale: A Swift-rendered native transcript would hardcode UI in the host - the exact anti-thesis of D3; the page knows only the loopback HTTP+WS protocol and renders projection events with zero host awareness.

nodes.label: host.info readiness signal
nodes.rationale: The readiness signal is the existing host.info gateway event, which the CLI backend also emits (port 0), so one scenario serves both hosts with no hostType branching (RFC 0002).

nodes.label: pending-receipt startup replay
nodes.rationale: Journal lines wrap {txId, receipt} because the frozen receipt schema is additionalProperties:false; replay verifies the staged tree (anchored by treeSha256) rather than re-fetching, since the cache is regenerable and carries no authority.

nodes.label: install-time capability negotiation
nodes.rationale: A host that never set a descriptor skips negotiation - the honest-absence reading of primitives.md section 7; gateway@1 is the host's own surface and always satisfied.

nodes.label: D5 contract first
nodes.rationale: The frozen receipt schema forbids additional properties (fail-loud contract); amending it for an implementation detail would be a major version bump for nothing.

nodes.label: m3-complete profile patch (host-side consumption)
nodes.rationale: The profile patch must be read host-side pre-eval because the page to serve is chosen before the page exists; the carrier enforces the slot allow-set so both shipped clients stay byte-identical and the denial is provable in the host log stream.

nodes.label: fsWrite append flat-args fix
nodes.rationale: FSPrimitives.write read append/create from a nested opts object while the gateway shim flattens them at the top level of the args JSON, so append silently overwrote; the receipt journal as first append caller exposed it.

nodes.label: __dshModuleDefine module-from-source seam
nodes.rationale: The ESM loader reads the bundle root from disk while installed files live in a storage scope on both the CLI and iOS hosts; a module-from-source seam keeps the scenario platform-neutral.

nodes.label: stage -> read-back verify -> promote atomic unpack
nodes.rationale: The frozen fs v1 has no rename primitive, so atomic unpack is approximated by stage -> read-back re-verify -> promote, with the receipt append as the authority/commit point.

nodes.label: plugin toolbar slot protocol (slot.register/slot.ack)
nodes.rationale: The page owns rendering and binds only id+label - a raw DOM channel would make the client an XSS surface; evidence is the page ack after DOM insertion (rendered state), not the send.

nodes.label: D9 official upstream web UI mount
index render boot-rows injection pipeline
nodes.rationale: The vendored dist is deliberately bare: __ModuleLoader__/__DSH_BOOT__ rows are carrier-injected or the page fails loud upstream-style, which is the documented correct failure mode.

nodes.label: node:fs staged web-plugin VFS shim
nodes.rationale: Mobile staging has no wall-clock meaning, so a fixed generation stamp keeps composed revs reproducible across runs/devices; VFS state lives on a global because quickjs compiles the shim under both its node:fs and bundle-relative names and module-local state would fork.

nodes.label: nine-primitive gateway conformance
nodes.rationale: Flipping the descriptor before the on-emulator proof would be faking availability (primitives.md section 7) - each primitive is proven first, then declared.

nodes.label: polled stage.ready credential handshake
nodes.rationale: hdc shell cannot create files in the app sandbox and chmodSync is a silent no-op, so only the C-side app-scope fsWrite lands 0666; removal, not permission bits, bounds the key's on-disk life.

nodes.label: log-sink credential audit
nodes.rationale: The scenario wraps the log sink from its first line, auditing every line for the active key and failing loud on a leak; the CLI leg audits a non-secret fixture key so the audit mechanism itself is under test in CI.

nodes.label: OfficialServe hook block seam
nodes.rationale: The seat reports serving FACTS; what a fact means (which canonical record, which scenario id, once or every time) is the drive's business - adding a fact means adding a hook, not an if(isRelease).

nodes.label: release/harness serving split
nodes.rationale: A RELEASE build IS the user-facing product: serving must be split from evidence behind a hook block because a file boundary is checkable by reading while a flag is checkable only by testing; duplicating serving logic would create a second copy that drifts by construction.

nodes.label: DSH_RELEASE release log strip
nodes.rationale: Full logging exists FOR TESTING; the release build is for users - release keeps warn/error only, and the branch must stay wired (rule L4).

nodes.label: host-injected globalThis.__DSH_RELEASE__ global
nodes.rationale: A staging-time prelude would put a second copy of the logger into release artifacts and break the byte-identity invariant across hosts; one C injection point (dsh_bind_globals) keeps logger.js byte-identical in both configurations.

nodes.label: async_hooks AsyncLocalStorage shim fix
nodes.rationale: quickjs-ng runs await continuations through its own job queue, not the patched Promise.then, so the store vanished at the first await and every session's first tool call failed with 'no initiating agent is active'; fixed by keeping a run() frame installed until its operation's promise settles.

nodes.label: app-scope workspace seeding
nodes.rationale: The profile's containerRoot was the bundle staging directory (deleted and rewritten on every launch, outside every granted scope); the seat seeds a real workspace inside the app scope and passes the scope root alongside.

nodes.label: refuse-by-name shell semantics
nodes.rationale: A command line that cannot be honoured must never quietly do something else: pipelines, redirection, globbing, environment and background jobs exit non-zero naming what is missing; an unknown program is the shell's own 127 not found.

nodes.label: D2 no subprocesses on the JS runtime
nodes.rationale: iOS has no shell binary and no way to spawn one; the question was never 'which shell do we bundle' but 'what can a shell BE on this host' - an in-process WASM interpreter, not a per-host native library like ios_system which would break the one-contract symmetry.

nodes.label: main branch protection policy
nodes.rationale: Pre-push hooks run on the pusher's machine and CI ran after landing, so direct pushes bypassed every gate; making the gov check required turns CI into the enforcement point, with enforce_admins false as a documented owner bypass.

nodes.label: tree-sitter exact span measurement
nodes.rationale: The signature+brace-depth heuristic mis-measures spans whenever strings contain braces and misses single-expression arrows; on a governed repo those errors make the gate an unreliable ruler, so exact spans replace it (heuristic kept as fallback).

nodes.label: code-size gate 500/50/5
nodes.rationale: Unenforceable promises violate gates-over-prose (rules.md rule 1); thresholds live in one place (tools/check-size.py constants) and changing them is a decision that needs a new note, not a quiet edit.

nodes.label: commit-format gate (Angular Conventional Commits)
nodes.rationale: An unparseable history breaks changelog generation, release notes and selective backports; the gate checks only the unpushed range so rewriting ancient history is out of scope and rebase flows are safe.

hyperedges.label: M2 session end-to-end proof chain (registry boot, plugins, session events)
D9 official web boot pipeline (runtime composer -> bus seam -> carrier render -> live module system)
DSH_RELEASE log-strip plumbing (C host injection, operative logger, gate L4, build matrix)
